collections.name: Harry Potter
collections.description: The Harry Potter films are a fantasy series based on the series of seven Harry Potter novels by British writer J. K. Rowling.

items.name: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets
Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban
Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire
Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix
Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince
Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 1
Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 2

collections.name: Fantastic Beasts
collections.description: The Fantastic Beasts films are a fantasy series based on and inspired by the textbook mentioned in the Harry Potter novels by British writer J. K. Rowling.

items.name: Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them
Fantastic Beasts: The Crimes of Grindelwald
Fantastic Beasts: The Secrets of Dumbledore

collections.name: The Lord of the Rings
collections.description: The Lord of the Rings trilogy consists of three epic fantasy films, based on the influential novels written by J. R. R. Tolkien, directed by Peter Jackson.

items.name: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers
The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King

collections.name: The Hobbit
collections.description: The Hobbit collection is a three-part epic fantasy-adventure film directed and produced by Peter Jackson and based on J. R. R. Tolkien's fantasy novel of the same name.

items.name: The Hobbit: The Desolation of Smaug
The Hobbit: The Battle of the Five Armies

collections.name: The Chronicles of Narnia
collections.description: Modern theatrical film productions based on the book series «The Chronicles of Narnia» by C. S. Lewis.

items.name: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe
The Chronicles of Narnia: Prince Caspian
The Chronicles of Narnia: The Voyage of the Dawn Treader

collections.name: The Dark Knight
collections.description: With minimal usage of CGI and a focus on character driven narratives, Christopher Nolan's dark, gritty portrayal of Bruce Wayne's transition into Batman and his struggles as Gotham's superhero set the precedent for modern superhero films.

collections.name: The Avengers
collections.description: A superhero film series produced by Marvel Studios based on the Marvel Comics superhero team of the same name, and part of the Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU).

collections.name: Iron Man
collections.description: A superhero film series based on the Marvel Comics character of the same name and part of the Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU) series.

collections.name: Captain America
collections.description: Steve Rogers wields the shield in Captain America: The First Avenger, Captain America: The Winter Soldier and Captain America: Civil War. Then it’s Sam Wilson who unleashes his wings and takes up the mantle in Captain America: Brave New World. Join them as they fight evil global forces.

collections.name: Thor
collections.description: A superhero film series based on the comic book character of the same name published by Marvel Comics, and part of the Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU) film series. The series centers on Thor, the crown prince of Asgard.

collections.name: Guardians of the Galaxy
collections.description: A superhero film series based on the Marvel Comics superhero team Guardians of the Galaxy, and part of the Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU) series. The series is centered on a band of former intergalactic outlaws, who have teamed together to protect the Galaxy from planetary threats.

collections.name: Spider-Man (MCU)
collections.description: A collection of films following Peter Parker as he navigates adolescence while taking on the responsibilities of being Spider-Man in a world filled with superheroes.

collections.name: Spider-Man (Raimi)
collections.description: A superhero film series based on the Marvel Comics character Spider-Man.

collections.name: Spider-Man: Spider-Verse
collections.description: An animated trilogy of Spider-Man films helmed by writers Phil Lord and Christopher Miller. The films follow Miles Morales and Gwen Stacy as they deal with various iterations of Spider-Man throughout the vast and infinite multiverse.

collections.name: X-Men
collections.description: A superhero film series about a team of mutant superheroes based on the Marvel Comics superheroes of the same name.

collections.name: Deadpool
collections.description: The Deadpool Collection centers on a sharp-tongued mercenary with regenerative powers, blending irreverent humor, stylized action, and self-aware storytelling.

collections.name: Star Wars
collections.description: An epic space-opera theatrical film series, which depicts the adventures of various characters "a long time ago in a galaxy far, far away…."

items.name: Star Wars: Episode I - The Phantom Menace
Star Wars: Episode II - Attack of the Clones
Star Wars: Episode III - Revenge of the Sith
Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker

collections.name: Star Trek (Kelvin)
collections.description: J.J. Abrams' cinematic re-envisioning of the Star Trek universe portrayed by a new cast, and set in an alternate reality from earlier films and series (referred to as the "Kelvin" timeline).

collections.name: Dune
collections.description: The Dune Collection chronicles a mythic journey across the desert planet Arrakis, where power, prophecy, and survival intertwine. With striking visuals and layered storytelling, it explores themes of destiny, politics, and ecological balance in a richly imagined sci-fi universe.

collections.name: The Matrix
collections.description: The Matrix collection depicts a complex science fiction story incorporating many philosophical elements. Written and directed by the Wachowskis and produced by Joel Silver.

collections.name: Alien
collections.description: A science fiction horror film franchise, focusing on Lieutenant Ellen Ripley (Sigourney Weaver) and her battle with an extraterrestrial life-form, commonly referred to as "the Alien".

collections.name: Predator
collections.description: A science fiction action film series centered on a warrior class extraterrestrial species with technologically advanced weaponry that travel to Earth to trophy hunt human beings.

collections.name: The Terminator
collections.description: A series of science-fiction films about the futuristic conflict between the humans led by John Connor and the Terminators that are made and controlled by Skynet, a self-aware super computer that started Armageddon and may indeed end humanity for good.

collections.name: Planet of the Apes
collections.description: Caesar, a laboratory chimpanzee, develops human intelligence and emotions, triggering an epic battle to determine which species will dominate planet Earth.

items.name: Rise of the Planet of the Apes
Dawn of the Planet of the Apes
War for the Planet of the Apes
Kingdom of the Planet of the Apes

collections.name: Back to the Future
collections.description: An American science fiction–comedy film series that follows the adventures of a high school student, Marty McFly and an eccentric scientist, Dr Emmett L. Brown as they use a DeLorean time machine to time travel to different periods in the history of Hill Valley, California.

items.name: Back to the Future Part II
Back to the Future Part III

collections.name: Men in Black
collections.description: A series of American science fiction action comedy films based on Malibu / Marvel comic book series The Men in Black by Lowell Cunningham. Stylized MIB and spawned 2 numbered sequels as well as a spin-off.

collections.name: Avatar
collections.description: The Avatar Collection tells the story of the world of Pandora, inhabited by the indigenous humanoids, the Na'vi. The main protagonist, Jake Sully, is sent to Pandora as an avatar—a hybrid of human and Na'vi.

collections.name: Jurassic Park
collections.description: An American science fiction adventure film series based on the novel of the same name by Michael Crichton.

collections.name: Indiana Jones
collections.description: Adventure film series created by George Lucas and Philip Kaufman starring Harrison Ford as archaeologist Dr. Henry Walton "Indiana" Jones, Jr., and directed by Steven Spielberg and James Mangold. Spanning the globe, on death-defying archeological endeavors, if adventure has a name...

items.name: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull
Indiana Jones and the Dial of Destiny

collections.name: Pirates of the Caribbean
collections.description: A series of fantasy swashbuckler films based on Walt Disney's theme park ride of the same name.

items.name: Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl
Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Man's Chest
Pirates of the Caribbean: At World's End
Pirates of the Caribbean: On Stranger Tides
Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Men Tell No Tales

collections.name: The Mummy
collections.description: The Mummy film series is a remake of The Mummy, loosely based on the original 1932 film. The first two films in the series were written and directed by Stephen Sommers.

items.name: The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor

collections.name: National Treasure
collections.description: The collection of theatrical action-adventure mystery films starring Nicolas Cage as Benjamin Gates, a treasure hunter who, with the help of his father, Patrick Henry Gates (Jon Voight), his girlfriend, Abigail Chase (Diane Kruger) and his loyal sidekick, Riley Poole (Justin Bartha), uncovers hid...

collections.name: James Bond
collections.description: The James Bond Collection is a legendary spy film series based on Ian Fleming’s novels, following MI6 agent 007, James Bond, as he takes on global threats with style, gadgets, and charm.

items.name: The Man with the Golden Gun

collections.name: Mission: Impossible
collections.description: Mission: Impossible is a series of a secret agent thriller films based on the popular 1966–73 television series. They chronicle the missions of a team of secret government agents known as the Impossible Missions Force (IMF) under the leadership of agent Ethan Hunt.

items.name: Mission: Impossible - Dead Reckoning Part One

collections.name: Bourne
collections.description: The Bourne films are a series of action thriller movies based on the character Jason Bourne, a CIA assassin suffering from extreme memory loss who must figure out who he is. The character is based on novels by Robert Ludlum.

collections.name: Kingsman
collections.description: A British-American film series based on the adventures of the agents of Kingsman, a fictional secret organization. The series began with the recruitment of an unrefined—but promising—street kid into the agency's ultra-competitive training program.

collections.name: John Wick
collections.description: A neo-noir action thriller film series that follows Jonathan 'John' Wick, a former assassin, who comes out of retirement seeking vengeance for the theft of his vintage car and the murder of the puppy his deceased wife left to him.

collections.name: Die Hard
collections.description: An action film series centered around the character of John McClane, a New York City police detective who finds himself fighting a group of terrorists in each film.

items.name: A Good Day to Die Hard

collections.name: Lethal Weapon
collections.description: Lethal Weapon is a buddy cop movie series starring Mel Gibson and Danny Glover. A total of four films have been made since the first one in 1987, and all have been a success at the box-office.

collections.name: Rush Hour
collections.description: The Rush Hour movie collection contains three martial arts/action-comedy films directed by Brett Ratner.

collections.name: Bad Boys
collections.description: A franchise of films about the cop duo Mike Lowrey and Marcus Burnett, blowing stuff up and crazy car chases. They get the job done but at an expensive cost.

collections.name: The Fast and the Furious
collections.description: An action film series centered on illegal street racing and heists.

items.name: The Fast and the Furious: Tokyo Drift

collections.name: Mad Max
collections.description: Mad Max is an Australian dystopian action media franchise. Mad Max references are deeply embedded in popular culture; references to its dystopian, apocalyptic, and post-apocalyptic themes and bizarre landscape and desolate wasteland imagery.

collections.name: The Expendables
collections.description: An ensemble action film series about a group of elite mercenaries. This series pays tribute to the blockbuster action films of the 1980s and early 1990s, starring an array of action veterans from those decades.

collections.name: Taken
collections.description: A French action thriller film series based upon fictional former CIA operative Bryan Mills who is abroad in Europe.

collections.name: The Equalizer
collections.description: The Equalizer is a 2014 American vigilante action thriller film, loosely based on the 1980s TV series of the same name. A sequel was released on July 20, 2018, with Washington and Fuqua returning. On August 30, 2023, a third movie was released making this series a trilogy.

collections.name: Kill Bill
collections.description: The Kill Bill Collection is a series of thrilling revenge dramas directed by Quentin Tarantino.

collections.name: Top Gun
collections.description: Top Gun is an American action drama multimedia franchise based on the 1983 article "Top Guns" by Ehud Yonay, which was adapted into the eponymous 1986 film, written by Jim Cash and Jack Epps Jr.

collections.name: Rocky
collections.description: These sport drama films begin by telling the rags to riches American Dream story of Rocky Balboa, an uneducated but kind-hearted working class Italian-American boxer working as a debt collector for a loan shark in the slums of Philadelphia.

collections.name: Creed
collections.description: Former World Heavyweight Champion Rocky Balboa serves as a trainer and mentor to Apollo Creed's son, Adonis. These films are both spin-offs and sequels to the Rocky film series.

collections.name: The Godfather
collections.description: Francis Ford Coppola’s trilogy films about the everyday life of a New York mafia family. With its star-studded cast these films would go down in history as some of the greatest Hollywood has ever produced.

collections.name: Ocean's
collections.description: The Ocean's Collection is a star-studded film series about a group of professional robbers who get together to pull off some mind-boggling heists.

collections.name: Now You See Me
collections.description: Now You See Me is a series of heist thriller films that focus on the actions of a team of illusionists named "The Four Horsemen" who pull off near impossible heists.

items.name: Now You See Me: Now You Don't

collections.name: The Hangover
collections.description: The Hangover is a 2009 American comedy film, co-produced and directed by Todd Phillips and written by Jon Lucas and Scott Moore. It is the first film of The Hangover franchise. The film stars Bradley Cooper, Ed Helms, Zach Galifianakis, Heather Graham, Justin Bartha, and Jeffrey Tambor.

collections.name: Meet the Parents
collections.description: The Meet the Parents films are a series of films involving a man and his in-laws.

collections.name: Austin Powers
collections.description: Austin Powers is a series of comedy films directed by Jay Roach and distributed by New Line Cinema, and written, produced by, and starring Mike Myers as the titular character.  The films follow Austin Powers, a British spy, and his quest to bring the villain Dr. Evil to justice.

items.name: Austin Powers: International Man of Mystery
Austin Powers: The Spy Who Shagged Me

collections.name: Ghostbusters
collections.description: Ghostbusters is a 1984 American supernatural comedy film, directed and produced by Ivan Reitman and written by Dan Aykroyd and Harold Ramis. The film stars Bill Murray, Aykroyd, and Ramis as three eccentric parapsychologists in New York City who start a ghost-catching business.

collections.name: Jumanji
collections.description: A series of films that follow several people playing a strange board game that unleashes all the creatures from the game's jungle into our world. The board game later turns into a video game, and when booted up, the players become the avatars of the characters they have selected.

collections.name: Night at the Museum
collections.description: A series of movies starring Ben Stiller as a night guard of the Museum of Natural History in New York City.

items.name: Night at the Museum: Battle of the Smithsonian
Night at the Museum: Secret of the Tomb

collections.name: Home Alone
collections.description: This series of movies sees a child accidentally left behind by their family during Christmas to fend for themselves against burglars.

items.name: Home Alone 2: Lost in New York

collections.name: The Hunger Games
collections.description: A science fiction film series based on the novel of the same name by Suzanne Collins. The film series takes place in a dystopian post-apocalyptic future in the nation of Panem.

collections.name: Twilight
collections.description: The Twilight movies are a romantic fantasy vampire series based on the series of novels by Stephenie Meyer.

items.name: The Twilight Saga: Breaking Dawn - Part 1
The Twilight Saga: Breaking Dawn - Part 2

collections.name: Divergent
collections.description: A series of dystopian science fiction action films based on the Divergent novels by the American author Veronica Roth. Set in a dystopian and post-apocalyptic Chicago where people are divided into distinct factions based on human virtues.

collections.name: The Maze Runner
collections.description: The Maze Runner series consists of  three science-fiction dystopian action adventure films based on the novel series by American author James Dashner.

collections.name: Before Trilogy
collections.description: The "Before" trilogy—comprising "Before Sunrise," "Before Sunset," and "Before Midnight"—chronicles the evolving relationship of Jesse and Céline, capturing their encounters across three different periods in their lives.

collections.name: The Conjuring
collections.description: A supernatural horror film series that started The Conjuring Universe and follows Ed and Lorraine Warren, paranormal investigators and authors associated with prominent cases of haunting.

items.name: The Conjuring: The Devil Made Me Do It

collections.name: Scream
collections.description: An American slasher series set largely around the fictional small town of Woodsboro, California, in which various groups of teens become the target of a masked killer, soon to be known nationwide as “Ghostface".

collections.name: Halloween
collections.description: Halloween is a horror film series that consists of slasher films focused on the fictional character of Michael Myers. Michael's killings occur on the holiday of Halloween, on which all of the films primarily take place.

items.name: Halloween III: Season of the Witch
Halloween 4: The Return of Michael Myers
Halloween 5: The Revenge of Michael Myers
Halloween: The Curse of Michael Myers

collections.name: Saw
collections.description: A mysterious murderer gives his victims macabre riddles they must solve to earn their freedom.

items.name: Spiral: From the Book of Saw

collections.name: It
collections.description: A two-part adaptation of Stephen King's iconic novel of the same name. Seven children in Derry, Maine are terrorized by an eponymous being, only to face their own personal demons in the process. This entity returns to haunt the children every 27 years.

collections.name: A Quiet Place
collections.description: A series of films that revolve around people struggling to survive in a post-apocalyptic world inhabited by blind extraterrestrial creatures with an acute sense of hearing.

collections.name: Final Destination
collections.description: Final Destination is a series of horror films centered on the themes of fatalism, predestination, and precognition, in relation to death.

collections.name: Evil Dead
collections.description: Supernatural horror-comedy franchise revolving around the Necronomicon and the demons summoned once its incantations are read.

collections.name: Toy Story
collections.description: Toy Story is a CGI animated media franchise created by Pixar and distributed by Walt Disney Pictures.

collections.name: Shrek
collections.description: The fairytale story of a large, strong, solitude-loving, intimidating ogre named Shrek, and his friends.

collections.name: How to Train Your Dragon
collections.description: This computer-animated action fantasy film series follows the adventures of a young Viking named Hiccup Horrendous Haddock III, son of Stoick the Vast, leader of the Viking island of Berk.

items.name: How to Train Your Dragon: The Hidden World

collections.name: Despicable Me
collections.description: The Despicable Me franchise centers on Gru, a supervillain (who later becomes a dad and a spy); his yellow-colored Minions; his three orphan girls, Margo, Edith and Agnes, and his wife Lucy Wilde.

collections.name: Kung Fu Panda
collections.description: The Kung Fu Panda series are computer-animated action comedy films set in a version of China populated by humanoid talking animals, the plot revolves around a bumbling humanoid panda named Po who aspires to be a kung fu master.

collections.name: Ice Age
collections.description: A collection of animated films centered around a woolly mammoth, a talkative sloth, a serious saber-toothed tiger, and a small squirrel, as they navigate through the Pleistocene Epoch.

items.name: Ice Age: Dawn of the Dinosaurs
The Ice Age Adventures of Buck Wild

collections.name: The Incredibles
collections.description: The Incredibles Collection is an American animated film series produced by Disney and created by Pixar Animation Studios.

collections.name: Frozen
collections.description: The Frozen Collection includes the enchanting adventures of sisters Elsa and Anna, set in the magical kingdom of Arendelle. This captivating series features the beloved animated films "Frozen" and "Frozen 2", as well as the charming short films "Frozen Fever" and "Olaf's Frozen Adventure".

collections.name: Cars
collections.description: A computer-animated action-adventure comedy film series that follows the adventures of Lightning McQueen and Mater, set in a world populated entirely by anthropomorphic cars and other vehicles.

collections.name: Finding Nemo
collections.description: A computer-animated adventure film series about a clownfish named Nemo, his over-protective father Marlin and a regal tang named Dory.

collections.name: Inside Out
collections.description: Inside Out Collection explores the inner world of emotions through vibrant, personified characters like Joy, Sadness, and Anxiety. Set inside the mind of a growing girl, the series blends humor, heart, and imagination to depict emotional change and self-discovery.

collections.name: Madagascar
collections.description: Madagascar is an animated film series produced by DreamWorks Animation. Voices of Ben Stiller, Jada Pinkett Smith, Chris Rock and David Schwimmer are featured in the films.

collections.name: Paddington
collections.description: A series of films based on the stories of the character of the same name created by Michael Bond. These follow the eponymous character Paddington, an anthropomorphic bear who migrates from the jungles of Peru.

collections.name: The Lion King
collections.description: The film franchise mainly revolves about a pride of lions who oversee a large swath of African savanna as their «kingdom» known as the Pride Lands, with their leader Simba watching over it as «king».

items.name: The Lion King II: Simba's Pride
